newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria sees no savings bank as key shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria sees no savings bank as key shareholder.

text.p: Spain's Argentaria Chairman Francisco Gonzalez said on Monday he did not expect savings banks to form part of the bank's core shareholders, which are more likely to be made up of industrial groups, international insurance companies and investment trusts.

"I don't see any saving banks entering the core of stable shareholders. But I do see several industrial groups, international insurance companies and international mutual investment companies in the core," he told reporters.
Gonzalez added that although several saving banks would be interested in making an investment in the group, he did not expect them to be part of the core shareholders.
Argentaria is still 29.2 percent state-owned and due for further privatisation this year.
